title: Carrier Synchronizer
text: Compensate for carrier frequency offset, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Modulation} sets Modulation type; {Modulation phase offset}, {Custom phase offset (radians)} sets the custom phase offset in radians, {Samples per symbol} sets the number of samples per symbol, {Damping factor}, {Normalized loop bandwidth} sets the normalized bandwidth of loop, {Estimated phase error output port} enables estimated phase error output port and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Phase corrected output signal scalar | column vector

ports.name: PhEst
ports.summary: Phase estimate in radians scalar | column vector

params.name: Modulation
params.values: Modulation type QAM (default) | 8PSK | BPSK | OQPSK | PAM | QPSK

params.name: Modulation phase offset
params.values: Modulation phase offset method Auto (default) | Custom

params.name: Custom phase offset (radians)
params.values: Custom phase offset in radians 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Samples per symbol
params.values: Number of samples per symbol 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Damping factor
params.values: Damping factor of loop 0.707 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Estimated phase error output port
params.values: Enable estimated phase error output port on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
